text:
Hi Ratu — you need a manufacturing website revamp that improves UI/UX, highlights the right content, and supports SEO.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’d be glad to help redesign and rebuild PT. GIH’s site into something clearer, faster, and easier to navigate for potential clients.

One relevant project was a Home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, where I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. That work improved the largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and increased organic traffic by 38% in 3 months.

I’d be happy to discuss your goals and the details you’ll share next.
